messages:
tess-finance: Heads up — ACH setup for customer 'GreenLeaf Clinics' (acct id GL-440) failed: bank returned 'account_closed'. They started verification yesterday.

ana-custops: ugh. Do we have the original bank details they submitted (routing + acct)?

tess-finance: routing 071000013, acct ****4321 (redacted). Customer swears it's their operating account.

billing-bot: System notice: microdeposit attempt 1 -> returned code 'R03_ACCOUNT_CLOSED' (pgw_tx_89b2). Scheduled retry in 24h.

ryan-sales: I just spoke with their finance lead — they say payroll moved the funds and closed the old account last week. They're trying to get new account but want to complete onboarding. Can we take card instead for first invoice?

lucy-ops: We can accept card as a temporary measure but need payment authorization on file + risk sign-off. What's invoice amount?
tess-finance: First invoice $2,150 (one-off). Customer comfortable with card but asks whether we can pause auto-retry on ACH while they update account.

paygate-sys: If we switch payment method we should cancel pending microdeposit retries to avoid duplicate attempts. I can cancel retries if someone confirms.

ana-custops: Confirm cancel retries. I'll collect new bank details or card on file. Also sending customer our secure link for bank update now.

ryan-sales: Customer sent screenshot of bank statement showing new account; can't share full PDF in chat. They asked if we can accept a bank letter instead of microdeposits.

lucy-ops: We typically allow bank letter in exceptional cases but need AML re-check and finance lead approval for manual verification. @tess-finance can you start KYC re-check?

billing-bot: Action required: manual verification workflow triggered for acct GL-440 (task_993).

ana-custops: Pasting guidance to customer (redacted):

"Please upload a bank letter from your bank confirming account ownership OR update your account via the secure form. If you upload a bank letter, please include account number suffix and routing. After we verify, we'll re-run ACH setup."

tess-finance: Starting KYC re-check now. Requesting bank letter + confirmation of account opening date. Estimated turnaround 1 business day.

ryan-sales: Customer wants to charge their corporate card immediately to avoid service disruption. Can ops take a one-time card auth and then switch to ACH once verified?

lucy-ops: Yes, we can do one-time card capture. We need written consent to store card for billing. Send link to card entry and note it's temporary.

ana-custops: Done — link sent. Customer completed card entry. Card auth succeeded (txn auth_775). Captured for invoice INV-4021.

billing-bot: Payment status: authorized -> captured for INV-4021. Microdeposit retries cancelled.

paygate-sys: Note: leaving account GL-440 flagged for manual re-verification. After bank letter is uploaded and KYC cleared, we'll remove flag and attempt ACH setup fresh.

tess-finance: Closing loop: card used to pay current invoice, ACH flow paused until bank letter + KYC done. Will reopen thread if anything odd shows in reconciliation. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
